'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**Fifty-seven [[National Police of Ecuador|police]] and [[prison officer]]s are taken [[hostage]] in six different prisons in [[Quito]] as explosive attacks occur in [[Ecuador]]'s capital targeting the country's prison authority. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/2023/09/01/car-bombs-rock-ecuador-capital-as-prisoners-seize-57-guards-police-says-officials/88412 (AFP via ''Malay Mail'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Nine soldiers are killed and five more injured during a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] against a convoy in [[Bannu District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://arynews.tv/nine-soldiers-martyred-in-bannu-suicide-attack-ispr/ (ARY News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**An [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldier]] is killed and two others injured during a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] at a [[border checkpoint|checkpoint]] in [[Beit Sira]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. The perpetrator is shot dead. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/31/israeli-soldier-killed-in-car-ramming-attack-by-palestinian (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Johannesburg building fire]]
**At least 73 people are killed by a fire in a [[City of Johannesburg Metropolitan Municipality|government]] building that had been taken over by gangs who rented it out to [[squatter]]s in [[Johannesburg]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/08/31/more-than-50-killed-in-fire-in-south-africas-johannesburg.html (CNBC)]
*Fifteen people are killed in a fire at a clothing factory in [[Quezon City]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-factory-fire-700c57d5140bc50de39d7850a2e95c3a (AP)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/08/31/world/asia/philippines-manila-factory-fire.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Five people are killed and seven others injured when a truck collides with several vehicles in [[La Guaira]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230901/4e43a51c77be4b1995e973528ba0c4e9/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Five people are killed and two others are injured when a [[passenger train]] collides with track workers doing maintenance work in [[Brandizzo]], [[Piedmont]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-66666981 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 Gabonese coup d'état]]
**The [[African Union]] announces the suspension of [[Gabon]]'s membership after [[Armed Forces of Gabon|the country's military]] instigates a [[coup d'état]]. [https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/31/08/2023/african-union-says-to-immediately-suspend-gabon-after-coup (AFP via ''The Peninsula'')]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**The [[Korean Central News Agency]] reports that [[Korean People's Army|North Korean forces]] has conducted drills simulating a [[Tactical nuclear weapon|nuclear missile strike]] on [[South Korea]], in protest of [[Republic of Korea Armed Forces|ROKAF]]-[[United States Armed Forces|USAF]] [[Military exercise|military drills]] said to simulate plans for a [[First strike (nuclear strategy)|preemptive nuclear attack]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korea-says-it-conducted-tactical-nuclear-strike-drill-2023-08-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sierra Leone–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] announces [[Visa policy of the United States|visa]] restrictions for [[Sierra Leoneans]] implicated in undermining recent [[Elections in Sierra Leone|elections]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/09/02/world/americas-emea/us-restricts-visas-over-sierra-leone-election-concerns/1908061 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

[https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/proud-boy-joe-biggs-faces-decades-prison-jan-6-seditious-conspiracy-ca-rcna102597 (NBC News)]
